meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 手头会多出 10 套配色+字体主题。你点名要某主题，它就按主题规格去改幻灯片、文档、网页等的外观；没有合适的，也能根据你的描述现场生成新主题，再应用到成品上。
howto.when: 当你想给幻灯片、文档、网页等换统一配色和字体，或要求按描述新做一套主题时，Claude 会先展示主题选项，确认后再动手。

say.text: 把这份幻灯片换成 Ocean Depths 主题。
say.note: 读取主题后应用到整套幻灯片。

say.text: 先展示一下所有可选主题。
say.note: 打开主题预览 PDF 供挑选。

say.text: 照这句话帮我做新主题：公司内部简洁风，深蓝配白。
say.note: 先生成新主题样本，确认后应用。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can style slide decks, docs, reports, HTML pages with one of 10 preset color/font themes, or create a fresh theme from your description, and applies it after showing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to restyle an artifact like slides, docs, reports, or a webpage with a unified palette and fonts, or when you ask Claude to create a new theme from your description.

say_en.text: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to my slides.
say_en.note: Applies the theme consistently to the whole deck.
Opens the showcase PDF for browsing.

say_en.text: Create a custom theme for a clean company look: dark blue and white.
say_en.note: Generates a sample theme; applied after approval.
